verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own programmatic surfaces: an MCP server and a one-command CLI [gusto-docs-12]. AI tools connected through them can answer payroll/team questions, prep payroll and generate reports [gusto-docs-10], with agents preparing work for owner approval [gusto-docs-13]. Nothing shows these surfaces match the full UI, such as banking, benefits enrollment, compliance filings or HR documents. missing for 10: a documented public API with stated UI parity, API coverage of the many UI features listed (formation, banking, benefits, 401(k), contractors, compliance), API reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic coverage.
